pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-01.png with Read and looked at it myself. Reading left to right, top to bottom. Panel 1 (full-width top tier, exterior of a small clinic with a teal awning): caption at top left, 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A woman in a white coat with a stethoscope stands in the doorway, smiling and waving an elderly woman in a lilac sari inside. Two patients sit on metal chairs at the right with their backs to us. No balloons here, so the welcoming gesture is the silent beat. Panel 2 (lower left, front desk): a receptionist in a blue kurta with a long braid, holding a phone receiver, writing in a ledger beside a stack of books, sweating a little with strain marks by her head. Patients' heads fill the foreground. Balloon 1 at top left, tail to the receptionist: 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...'. Balloon 2 at right, lower and tail to the same receptionist: 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Panel 3 (lower right): the doctor stands in the foreground with her hand at her chin, thinking, looking toward the desk. The receptionist is still on the phone in the background. Balloon at top, tail to the doctor: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' Page number '1' at the bottom.
pages.observation: The order is clear. In panel 2 the left balloon sits higher than the right one, so the list is read before the wish, and both tails reach the receptionist without crossing her face. The doctor's tail in panel 3 points correctly to her head. No lettering covers a face, a hand, the phone or the ledger. Panel 2's top-left tail passes over plain wall only. Ambiguities: (1) In panel 2 the receptionist is holding a phone to her ear and smiling while she says her complaint, so a reader may wonder whether she is talking to the caller or to herself. (2) In panel 3 the doctor seems to be thinking aloud with her hand at her chin, and nobody visibly hears her, so 'Let's make the rest simpler' reads as a resolution she makes to herself rather than a reply to the receptionist. This is acceptable but slightly loose. (3) The only identification of the woman in the white coat as Dr. Ananya is the caption plus her coat. That is enough. Her hair looks loose with strands in panel 1 and in a bun in panel 3, which is a small continuity difference. Nothing is unreadable.
